name: zcode-auto-rename
description: Local marketplace for the zcode-auto-rename plugin.

plugins.name: zcode-auto-rename
plugins.description: Auto-rename ZCode sessions with sub-project tags: a Stop hook analyzes user inputs and tool paths and generates titles via rules or an optional GLM engine, plus an on-demand /rename-session command.

description_i18n.en: Auto-rename ZCode sessions with sub-project tags: a Stop hook analyzes user inputs and tool paths and generates titles via rules or an optional GLM engine, plus an on-demand /rename-session command.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 会话自动重命名插件：Stop hook 分析用户输入与工具操作路径，识别子项目标签与主线目标，规则引擎或可选 GLM 引擎生成标题，另提供 /rename-session 命令按需主动重命名。
